plain: The .tracking-widest class and a few stray Tailwind CSS variables (including --tracking-wider) are no longer shipped, and the ESLint plugin now errors on hand-set letter-spacing; use <Text variant> or a .hds-type-<role> class.

steps.plain: The stray CSS variable --color-slate-200 is no longer shipped (a Tailwind scan of repo docs generated it as a side effect, never a documented token); set your own value if you read it.
The stray CSS variable --color-slate-900 is no longer shipped (a Tailwind scan of repo docs generated it as a side effect, never a documented token); set your own value if you read it.
The stray CSS variable --color-stone-50 is no longer shipped (a Tailwind scan of repo docs generated it as a side effect, never a documented token); set your own value if you read it.
The stray CSS variable --container-5xl is no longer shipped (a Tailwind scan of repo docs generated it as a side effect, never a documented token); set your own value if you read it.
The stray CSS variable --font-serif is no longer shipped (a Tailwind scan of repo docs generated it as a side effect, never a documented token); set your own value if you read it.
The stray CSS variable --tracking-wider is no longer shipped; type tracking comes from the --semantic-typography-*-letter-spacing tokens, so use a type role instead.
The .tracking-widest class is no longer shipped; use <Text variant> or a .hds-type-<role> class, which set tracking from the type tokens.
